title: Magnitude and threshold sign
statement: For every real number $r$, its absolute value multiplied by its threshold sign—$1$ when $r\geq0$ and $-1$ when $r<0$—equals $r$.
replaced:
For every $r\in\mathbb R$, define $\sigma(r)=1$ when $r\ge0$ and $\sigma(r)=-1$ when $r<0$.
Then $|r|\sigma(r)=r$.
